title: Full-stack Software Developer
bio: I’m a software engineer currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I have experience in Go, Python, C++, and JavaScript, with a focus on backend development and building command-line tools. While I specialize in backend systems, I am also capable of full-stack development. I have successfully deployed live products and am driven to create scalable, efficient systems. My goal is to continue honing my software engineering skills and contribute to impactful projects.
